description: inbox.list is one live evaluation (SV1): items in inbox order (severity class, then oldest, then key), each with the daemon's stored reason VERBATIM, the age computed at read, and the door a person takes; sources[] is the FULL census — questions reported, the four sibling slots name themselves not-wired — so an empty list can never silently mean 'nothing was looking'. Nothing here is stored: the same params a minute later answer with older ageSeconds and could carry different items.

door.sentence: Answer with `aeon answer refactor-auth <one of: approve | deny>` or in the app.

items.reason: unattended loop denied an outward action

door.sentence: This loop is unattended, so outward actions are denied. Start an attended run, or (S56) grant the action.
